name: oldlstat
synopsis: int lstat(const char *restrict pathname, struct stat *restrict statbuf);
description: oldlstat is an older version of lstat, which retrieves file status information for a given pathname. It is identical to stat, except that if the pathname is a symbolic link, it returns information about the link itself rather than the file it refers to.

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Pathname of the file or symbolic link

parameters.name: statbuf
parameters.description: Pointer to the stat structure where file status information is stored

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Search permission is denied for one of the directories in the path prefix of pathname
fd is not a valid open file descriptor (though not directly for oldlstat)
Too many symbolic links encountered while traversing the path
A component of pathname does not exist or is a dangling symbolic link
A component of the path prefix of pathname is not a directory
Pathname refers to a file whose size, inode number, or number of blocks cannot be represented

bugs: Fields in the stat structure may contain state information from different moments during execution, and use of st_blocks and st_blksize may be less portable across systems.
